title: FBO-DNVP: Fuzzy–Bayesian Optimization of dynamic natural ventilation protocols
description:
R code, EnergyPlus models, monitoring data and evaluation logs supporting the article Balancing indoor air quality, thermal comfort and energy in naturally ventilated classrooms: A Fuzzy–Bayesian Optimization approach (manuscript submitted for publication).

Contents: two-track calibration of a classroom EnergyPlus model (thermal, Track A; CO2 mass balance, Track B); hierarchical Mamdani scoring of five annual indicators (CO2 excess, adaptive comfort shortfall, overcooling, control effort, outdoor-pollutant import); Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization of five DNVP setpoints over nine orientation–aperture scenarios; NSGA-II and fixed-threshold benchmarks. verify_without_energyplus.R reproduces every stage that does not require EnergyPlus.

Licences: code MIT; data, models and logs CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). The ASHRAE IWEC weather file is not redistributed.
notes: Software environment: R, EnergyPlus 9.4.0 (DesignBuilder 7.3.1.003), Python 3.13 + eppy 0.5.69.
